info.name: BookStore_API_Tests
info.description:
## BookStore API Tests

This collection contains automated API tests for the BookStore application.  
It covers end-to-end scenarios including user registration, authentication,  
book management, and account cleanup.

### Base URL

All requests use the `{{baseURL}}` environment variable.

---

### Folders & Test Scenarios

#### Register User

Tests for the user registration endpoint (`POST /account/v1/user`):

- Successful registration with valid credentials
    
- Validation errors: missing username, missing password, short password, missing all data
    
- Duplicate registration (user already exists)
    

#### BookStore Login

Tests for authentication endpoints:

- Successful login and token generation (`POST /account/v1/generateToken`)
    
- Authorization check with valid token (`POST /account/v1/authorized`)
    
- Failed login: invalid credentials, missing credentials
    

#### Add, get, delete books

Tests for book management (`/bookStore/v1/books`):

- Get all available books
    
- Add a single book and two books to user account
    
- Get user profile with added books
    
- Delete a single book, delete all books
    
- Unauthorized attempts to add or delete books
    

#### CleanUp

- Deletes the test user account after the test run (`DELETE /account/v1/user/{{userId}}`)
    

---

### Collection-Level Scripts

**Pre-request script** sets up shared test data variables used across all requests:

- Credentials for negative test cases (`badUsername`, `badPassword`, `shortPassword`)
    
- Expected response messages for validation and authorization errors
    
- JSON Schema definitions for response validation (registration, login, books, user profile, authorization)
    

**Test script** runs after every request and includes:

- Request/response logging to the Postman console
    
- Response time assertion (below 2000ms)
    
- Content-Type header validation
    
- Automatic JSON Schema validation based on request name
    

---

### Environment

Requires the `BookStore_API_Environment` environment with the `baseURL` variable configured.

---

## AI Assistance

Postman AI was used to assist with improving and refining an existing Postman collection.  
All changes were manually reviewed, adjusted, and validated before being committed.

**Author:** MinaLazicic

---

item.name: User should not be able to login with invalid credentials

exec: pm.test("Assert that Status code is 200", function () {
pm.test("Assert invalid values of properties", function () {

request.description:
Verifies that token generation fails when invalid credentials are provided. Expects HTTP 200 with a response body containing null token and expires fields, status 'Failed', and a failure result message.

Note: HTTP 200 here is intentional and expected — this is the BookStore API's design decision. The API always returns 200 for the /generateToken endpoint, regardless of whether authentication succeeded or failed. The actual outcome is indicated by the 'status' field in the response body ('Success' or 'Failed'), not by the HTTP status code.

item.description: Contains tests for authentication endpoints. Covers token generation (POST /account/v1/generateToken) with valid and invalid credentials, login without credentials, and user authorization verification (POST /account/v1/authorized) with a valid token.

item.description: Contains tests for the BookStore book management endpoints. Covers retrieving all books (GET /bookStore/v1/books), adding a single book and two books to the user account (POST /bookStore/v1/books), retrieving the user profile with added books (GET /account/v1/user/:userId), deleting a single book (DELETE /bookStore/v1/book), deleting all books (DELETE /bookStore/v1/books), and unauthorized add/delete attempts.
